title: erithalis fruticosa subsp. odorifera
intro: Erithalis fruticosa subsp. odorifera, commonly known as Sweet Erithalis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Erithalis fruticosa subsp. odorifera include analgesic and antiseptic properties, making it useful in pain relief and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
